3 cards: pick 1. Each card adds a new behaviour to your spells.
Edit slot 4, test it in the range. Invalid spells show why.
Guild prices. No haggling, no credit.
Pick what you need. The Guild keeps the ledger.

Done. Mind the rift on the way out.
Put a rune into an empty slot: open it to edit.

Deals water damage, applies Wet and puts out Burning.
Deals lightning damage; on a Wet target it arcs once to the nearest other Wet target.
Fires a single bolt in a straight line that ends on its first hit.
Hits every target within a 75-unit radius at once.
Circles you at 72 units for 6 seconds, hitting what it touches.
Projectile turns toward the nearest target within 280 units.
Projectile fires as 3 bolts spread across 17 degrees.
Projectile passes through targets, hitting up to 3 different ones.
